summary.text: A mental capacity assessment can be done by any doctor registered with the Singapore Medical Council.

details.heading: Ask the assessor first
details.body: An MOH-accredited severe disability assessor may be able to do the mental capacity assessment. Ask whether he or she can perform it before booking a disability assessment appointment.

example_phrasings: Can an MOH-accredited severe disability assessor certify the applicant’s mental capacity for CareShield Life claims?
Can an assessor check mental capacity?
Can an MOH-accredited assessor do this?

sources.page_title: Can an MOH-accredited severe disability assessor certify the applicant’s mental capacity for CareShield Life claims?

quotes.text: A mental capacity assessment can be completed by any doctor registered with the Singapore Medical Council.

If you require a mental capacity assessment, you may wish to ask your assessor if he/she is able to perform a mental capacity assessment, before you proceed to make a disability assessment appointment.
